summary: Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 3, 2026, announcing only that it expects to publish Q3 2026 operating and financial results on November 12, 2026, with a remote analyst/investor presentation and webcast that day at 2pm London time. No transaction, shareholder action, or corporate event terms are disclosed. Nomad and broker Cavendish, financial PR Camarco, and VFEX sponsor IH Securities are listed as enquiries. This is a routine earnings-timing notice; no deal or risk-arb angle exists, and attention centers solely on the November 12 results.
